property_summary: Because msg.value is already included in address(this).balance during the payable call, the reference contract's 'if (msg.value >= address(this).balance)' triggers whenever the contract held zero balance beforehand, forcing a transfer of double the value that must revert; the mutant's strict '>' never triggers on a zero-balance contract, so any positive-value multiplicate succeeds there instead of reverting.
change_summary: Change the if condition from >= to > so calls where msg.value equals the contract balance no longer trigger the transfer.
